meta.topic: Whether each named hotel requires government-issued photo ID and/or a payment card at check-in, as the hotel or its brand publishes it
meta.method: WebSearch to find each hotel's policy/FAQ/terms page; WebFetch or curl to read that page. Quotes are verbatim from the page named in `url`. Where the hotel's own page could not be read (bot-blocked or rendered client-side), the record carries the claim from a search summary or booking site with confirmed=false.

fieldMeanings.photoIdAtCheckIn: true = the page states photo/official ID is required at check-in for every stay; "conditional" = the page requires it only in stated circumstances (cash payment, on request, police-form countries), see `condition`; null = the page read says nothing about ID at check-in; false = the page says ID is not required (no page said this)
fieldMeanings.cardAtCheckIn: true = page states a card must be presented or pre-authorised at check-in; "conditional" = only in stated circumstances; null = page silent
fieldMeanings.confirmed: true only when the quote was read on the hotel's or its brand's own page on the date given
fieldMeanings.thirdPartyClaim: what booking sites / search summaries say, recorded only for context where the own page is silent or unreadable; not a source

hotels.whatIdAccepted: valid government-issued ID
hotels.quote: Pod Times Square Hotel guests must only be at least 18 years old to check-in. Just bring along a valid government-issued ID and we'll have you living the #PodLife ASAP. | Pod Times Square accepts all major credit cards, and a credit or debit card is required for check-in. | The full amount of your stay, plus a $50 refundable security deposit, is authorized at arrival.
hotels.note: Page says 'government-issued ID', not explicitly 'photo'. Credit OR debit card accepted at check-in.

hotels.whatIdAccepted: valid government or state-issued photo ID
hotels.quote: Please note that for security purposes, you will be asked to provide a valid government or state-issued photo ID at check-in and a credit card. | Your credit card will be authorized at check-in for room + taxes + $300 for any incidentals.
hotels.note: Same FAQ: 'You must be 21 or older to book a room.'

hotels.condition: Brand (Accor/Fairmont) terms: ID must be shown where local regulations require a police form; the hotel 'may' ask for ID for card-fraud prevention. The Plaza's own FAQ is silent on ID.
hotels.whatIdAccepted: an ID document (type not specified)
hotels.quote: In accordance with the regulations in force in certain countries, the Customer may be asked to complete a police form on arrival at the Establishment. To do so, the Customer must present an ID document to enable the Establishment to check whether a police form must be completed by the Customer. | ...the Customer must present the credit card to the Establishment that they used to guarantee the reservation or make the pre-payment. The Establishment may also ask the Customer to present an identification document for the purpose of credit card fraud prevention.
hotels.note: Hotel's own FAQ (https://www.theplazany.com/faqs/) read: only 'Check-In time is 3:00 p.m. and check-out is at 12:00 p.m.' — nothing on ID or card. Quote is Accor's general terms for bookings via all.accor.com, which covers Fairmont properties; it is brand-wide, not Plaza-specific.
hotels.thirdPartyClaim: Booking sites: 'Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card at check-in.'

hotels.whatIdAccepted: Driver's License, Passport or National ID card, for all guests
hotels.quote: Valid photo identification for all Guests in the form of a Driver's License, Passport or National ID card is required at check-in. (s.6.2) | Freehand may require each Guest to present a valid payment card upon check-in or in advance, on which an amount of sufficient pre-authorization can be obtained. (s.3.5)
hotels.note: Brand-wide Booking Terms & Conditions; no Los Angeles exception. The LA FAQ (https://freehandhotels.com/los-angeles/faqs/) is silent on ID but says 'A refundable deposit of $75 is required for all guest rooms' and that cash payers 'will be required to provide a higher deposit per room at check-in.' Advance-purchase rates: 'we require the payment card used for booking to be presented upon check in.'

An authorization will be placed on the card at the time of check-in to cover room, tax and estimated incidental charges.
TIMING Check-in from 3pm, check-out by 12pm
hotels.note: Own overview/policy list read in full (timing, extra bed, pets, photography, smoking, taxes, parking, transfers, accessible rooms): no ID or card-at-check-in statement.
hotels.thirdPartyClaim: Booking sites: 'Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card upon check-in.'

hotels.hotel: Travelodge London Kings Cross Royal Scot
hotels.condition: On request at any time; always for cash pay-on-arrival or walk-in bookings; may be asked as proof of age.
hotels.whatIdAccepted: driver's licence, passport or national ID card
hotels.quote: You must be able to show photo identification (a driver's licence, passport or national ID card) or the credit or debit card used to make your booking if requested by Travelodge at any time. If you are unable to produce this to the satisfaction of the hotel we may terminate your booking without refund. | You must be able to show photo identification (a driver's licence, passport or national ID card) and a valid credit or debit card if you are paying by cash for a pay on arrival or walk-in booking at a Travelodge hotel. | We may require photo identification (a driver's licence or passport) as proof of age.
hotels.note: Brand-wide UK booking terms; first sentence's exact wording came from the search summary of this page and was confirmed in substance by the fetch.

hotels.whatIdAccepted: passport, driving licence, ID card or police warrant card
hotels.quote: Guests will be asked to provide proof of identity and nationality upon check-in. Overseas guests, excluding Republic of Ireland and Commonwealth citizens, will be asked to complete a registration form and provide their identity card / passport details. Acceptable forms of identification are: a passport, driving licence, ID card or police warrant card. | We reserve the right to request valid photographic proof of identity and age, so please bring this with you and ensure all guests under your booking bring identification, otherwise where requested you and/or your guests will not be permitted to stay.
hotels.note: Brand-wide UK terms, read via curl. Cash accepted 'up to a maximum of £10,000 per transaction (with proof of identification)'. No statement that a card must be shown at check-in.

hotels.whatIdAccepted: the booking card (PIN or signature) serves as proof of ID

An amount will be pre-authorised for £50 per night to cover any incidentals.
hotels.note: No photo-ID statement on the terms page or the Holborn FAQ (https://thehoxton.com/london/holborn/faqs/). The card itself is the stated proof of ID. Per search summary of the same page: if the card holder is not present a third-party payment form must be completed before check-in.

hotels.whatIdAccepted: INE (voter credential) or valid passport, for every person staying in the room; CURP for minors
hotels.quote: Se requiere INE o pasaporte vigente para el registro al check-in. | Al check-in, el hotel solicitará un documento oficial de identidad vigente. Card: 'Se requiere una tarjeta de crédito al momento de realizar la reserva.' and it must belong to the reservation holder ('No se aceptan tarjetas a nombre de terceros.'); balance 'se liquida a su llegada en efectivo, tarjeta de crédito o débito' — no card required at check-in as such. Only minors accompanied by an adult. The page does not use the word 'photo', but INE and passport are photo documents.

notFound: The Beverly Hills Hotel — own policy list silent on ID and card.
The Study at Yale — no FAQ/policy page found on thestudyatyale.com; homepage silent.
The Hoxton, Holborn — no photo-ID statement; the card (PIN/signature) is the stated proof of ID.
The Dean Dublin — own FAQ silent.
The Westbury — own FAQ and Doyle Collection terms silent on ID (card pre-authorisation required).
Sandman Signature Vancouver Downtown — no general ID statement on own site (Government Rate page only).
Rosewood Hotel Georgia — own policy page silent on ID.
The Plaza, Fairmont Royal York, Fairmont Hotel Vancouver, Fairmont Pacific Rim — property pages silent; only Accor brand-wide terms apply (recorded as conditional).

Own page unreadable (records unconfirmed): La Quinta New Haven and Days Inn Vancouver Downtown (Wyndham policy panel rendered client-side); Four Seasons Toronto and Four Seasons Mexico City (fourseasons.com 403).
caveats: Brand-wide terms (Freehand, Travelodge UK, Travelodge Ireland, Premier Inn, Doyle Collection, Accor) were used where the property's own page is silent; each such record says so.

Booking sites (Expedia group) print a near-identical boilerplate ('Guests are required to show a photo ID and credit card at check-in') for almost every hotel; it is recorded only as thirdPartyClaim and never as a confirmed finding.
